About I THOUGHT SO!

I THOUGHT SO! is a social sentence-completion and guessing game for 2–6 people sharing the same device. The game includes 800 built-in prompts in 11 built-in categories.

How to play

  1. Before starting, add players (2–6), select the total number of rounds, and choose Random or any combination of categories.
  2. Click Start Game. Category and round-count selections are locked for the duration of that game.
  3. In round 1, Player 1 is the answer-setter. They enter their own completion and click Lock Answer or Pass.
  4. Every other visible player then guesses the answer-setter’s missing words, one player at a time. Each must lock their guess or pass.
  5. All answers stay hidden until all visible players have locked or passed. Then tap Reveal All Answers.
  6. Compare guesses with the setter’s locked answer. Award 1 point to each guesser who matched. The setter does not score for setting the answer.
  7. In round 2, Player 2 becomes the setter; in round 3, Player 3; and so on, rotating through players still in the game.
  8. One question is played per round. The game ends after the chosen number of rounds, or earlier if End Game is selected. The highest score wins; tied scores share the lead.

Intimacy (18+) and Create Your Own

The optional Intimacy category contains 50 adult-oriented questions about sexual preferences, romantic closeness, consent, and boundaries. All participants must be 18 or older to enable this category. In Create Your Own rounds, the answer-setter writes an original question and a private reference answer. Other players guess and lock their answers before reveal. Participants can always pass. Avoid entering passwords, identifying details, or sensitive information about others.

Passing and leaving

Any player may pass, counting as a completed response without earning a point. If the setter passes, all guesses still finish before reveal, but nobody can score that round. Player Exit removes the selected player from the roster; their pending response no longer counts. If a player exits, the next round’s setter is chosen from players remaining.

Question selection

The game includes 800 offline built-in questions, shuffled without repeats per game. Choose one or more built-in categories, Random for all built-in categories, or Create Your Own. For mixed games, custom question rounds appear at randomly shuffled positions. Leave the custom round count blank for an automatic allocation, or enter an exact number. Every custom round counts as one question toward the fixed round limit. Category and round settings cannot change after starting. Restart Game clears the score and returns to setup; End Game displays the final scores early.

Privacy

This standalone HTML version runs in your browser without accounts or an internet connection. Names, answers, scores, and category choices are used only in the page while it is open. The game does not send these details to a server, has no built-in analytics, advertising trackers, cookies, or online leaderboard, and does not intentionally store answers beyond the current play session. Closing or refreshing the page clears the in-memory session. Anyone physically viewing the screen during a reveal can see the responses; pass the device privately when answering.

Age, content and accessibility

This is a social entertainment game. Questions may touch on relationships, humor, personal preferences or life experiences. Players can pass any question. For best accessibility, use your browser’s zoom, keyboard navigation, and assistive features.

Offline use and limitations

Only local, pass-the-device play is supported by this downloadable edition. “Invite Others” adds a local player to the roster before the game starts; it does not send invitations to other devices. No account, payment, subscription or data connection is required.
